caption: The drawing features a single green jug with a glossy finish, depicted near the center of a plain, beige background. The jug has a rounded body that tapers toward the neck and a handle attached from the shoulder to the rim. The surface of the jug displays varying shades of green, with darker and lighter areas providing a textured, reflective appearance. The base of the jug is brown, indicating an unglazed or exposed portion. The outline of the jug is contained within a rectangular frame, sketched lightly in pencil, which is itself centered on the drawing surface. The background is otherwise unembellished, leaving the jug as the sole subject of the composition.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
